name: Pixel Paint Universe
summary:
Pixel Paint Universe is a pixel art studio where you can build sprites, room-scale scenes, or entire explorable pixel-art worlds.  It features easy to use, intuitive tools.  You can even add collision to pieces of your world, creating walls, ramps, stairs, platforms, and more.  Choose from different floors and skies to set the mood of your world, from bright outdoor scenes to a pure black creative canvas.

Not a pixel artist (yet)? Import sprites to your headset from your PC to start building quickly.
